parameters.help_en: The software ID in the software library. The value can be up to 64 characters in length. You can call [ListSoftwarelibSoftware](~~ListSoftwarelibSoftware~~) to obtain the value
parameters.help_zh: 软件库中的软件ID。长度不超过64个字符。取值来源：[ListSoftwarelibSoftware](~~ListSoftwarelibSoftware~~)
parameters.name: software_id

parameters.help_en:
The operating system to which the software package applies. Valid values:
Windows: Windows.
Mac(Apple): macOS with Apple silicon.
Mac(Intel): macOS with Intel processors
parameters.help_zh:
软件包适用的操作系统。取值：
Windows：Windows系统。
Mac(Apple)：Apple芯片的macOS系统。
Mac(Intel)：Intel芯片的macOS系统
parameters.name: os

parameters.help_en: The software version number. The value can be up to 64 characters in length. The combination of operating system and version number must be unique within the same software. If a duplicate exists, a ResourceDuplicated error is returned
parameters.help_zh: 软件版本号。长度不超过64个字符。同一软件下操作系统与版本号的组合不可重复，重复时返回ResourceDuplicated错误
parameters.name: software_version

parameters.help_en: The download URL of the software package. If the publisher type is local, the value is the relative path of the software package in the OSS bucket. If the publisher type is thirdparty, the value is a third-party download URL
parameters.help_zh: 软件包下载地址。软件发布者类型为local时，取值为软件包在OSS Bucket中的相对路径；为thirdparty时，取值为第三方下载链接
parameters.name: software_url

parameters.help_en: The MD5 value of the software package. The value can be up to 64 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 软件包的MD5值。长度不超过64个字符
parameters.name: md5

parameters.help_en: The file name of the software package. The value can be up to 128 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 软件包文件名称。长度不超过128个字符
parameters.name: software_pkg_name

parameters.help_en: The size of the software package
parameters.name: software_pkg_size

parameters.help_en: The software name. The value can be up to 128 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 软件名称。长度不超过128个字符
parameters.name: software_name

parameters.help_en:
The software publisher type. Valid values:
local: local upload.
thirdparty: third-party link
parameters.help_zh:
软件发布者类型。取值：
local：本地上传。
thirdparty：第三方链接
parameters.name: publisher_type

VersionId.description_en: The ID of the software version that was created
